name: web-fashion-store-site-on-tablet-held-in-studio
title: Fashion Store on a Tablet in a Studio
whatItIs: Hands hold a tablet showing a white fashion store with a hero photo of coats on a rail and the heading 'CloudeyStyles.', in a softly blurred photo studio with a tripod.
whatItMeans: A relaxed studio setting fits a fashion brand, and the photo hero inside the screen ties the site to the scene.
techniques: Big overlaid title on a photo hero
Centred heading section below the hero
Neutral clothing to keep focus on the screen

vocabulary.definition: A device shown in hands rather than on a surface.
A hero section built around a large photograph.
A softly defocused workspace as a backdrop.
